channel.title: NSY — Insights
channel.description: Practitioner field notes: AI applied to the web, SEO/GEO, critical systems. By Cédric Barme (NSY).

item.title: From terabytes to megabytes: monitoring is a discipline before it is a budget
item.description: Monitoring and observability at two scales: Dynatrace and ELK at a large insurance company, the dashboard of a small-business website. Terabytes versus megabytes a month, the same four questions, the golden rule on false alerts — and what AI really brings.

item.title: Building your website with AI in a weekend: we took the promise at its word
item.description: The vibe-coding promise tested on a real case: nsy.fr. V1 in 4 evenings, then nearly 140 hours of piloting measured action by action — the 10/90 rule, and why AI isn't just about going faster but going further.

item.title: Wiring an AI chatbot into a forum: web 1.0 as a knowledge base
item.description: Years of enthusiast discussions sleep inside forums. Field report from prv-concept.com: an AI chatbot that queries the phpBB database directly, with the anti-hallucination guardrails that make the difference.

item.title: SEO vs GEO: getting cited by ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity
item.description: Ranking on Google is no longer enough: AI assistants pick their sources differently. SEO vs GEO explained by a practitioner, with the concrete nsy.fr case.
